## History

After enjoying a concert with her classmates, Sam and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) raced into the spare-room bed at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), unaware that Diana's [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) was sleeping in it. The sudden intrusion caused [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) to react angrily, leading her to threaten to cut short her visit and cancel Diana's music lessons.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XIX.
